# Series B - Process Tracker

**Owner:** Aleks Varga. Engineering, security and compliance diligence: Maya Chen. Financial: Jordan Ellis.
**Status:** Term sheet signed with Northfield Ventures. Confirmatory diligence in progress. Target close Nov 14.

## Terms at a glance

- Lead: Northfield Ventures, partner Ravi Menon. Term sheet issued Sep 22.
- $38M at $210M post-money.
- Granite Peak Capital (Dana Whitaker) taking pro-rata.
- Summary and negotiation points in Northfield Term Sheet - Summary and Open Points.

## Fund pipeline

First meetings ran Jul 9 to Aug 28. 14 funds met. Names below are our internal shorthand.

| Fund | First meeting | Stage reached | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northfield Ventures | Jul 14 | Term sheet (Sep 22) | Lead, signed |
| Harborline Capital | Jul 16 | Partner meeting | Passed Sep 18 (wanted card live first) |
| Cedar Row Partners | Jul 21 | Second meeting | Passed (consumer exposure) |
| Meridian Growth | Jul 23 | Partner meeting | Paused; may join round as follow-on |
| Alder Street Ventures | Jul 28 | Second meeting | Passed (valuation) |
| Six others | Jul-Aug | First meeting | Passed or went quiet |
| Three others | Aug | First meeting | Not a fit for stage |

Our read: interest concentrated in funds with a regulated-fintech thesis. The ACH rebuild and the SOC 2 Type I report came up in every second meeting. Generalist consumer funds dropped out early.

## Timeline

- [x] Aleks: pitch process kicked off by 2026-07-09
- [x] Aleks: 14 first meetings completed by 2026-08-28
- [x] Maya: data room v1 ready to share under NDA by 2026-08-14
- [x] Aleks: term sheet negotiated and signed by 2026-09-25
- [ ] Maya: data room engineering section (architecture narrative, scale metrics, security policies, SOC 2 status letter) by 2026-10-12
- [ ] Maya: technical diligence call with Elena Sorensen by 2026-10-14 (prep in Technical Diligence Prep - Elena Sorensen Call)
- [ ] Jordan: financial diligence responses to Northfield by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Hana: compliance diligence pack (BSA/AML program, Pillar relationship, investing disclosures) by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Aleks: legal docs to counsel for first turn by 2026-10-23
- [ ] Aleks: close by 2026-11-14

## Diligence request log

| Request | From | Owner | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Architecture narrative | Elena Sorensen | Maya | Oct 12 | Drafting (Data Room - Architecture Narrative v2) |
| SOC 2 status letter | Northfield | Maya / Sam Whitfield | Oct 12 | Drafting |
| Incident history incl. Sep 26 | Northfield | Maya | Oct 12 | Postmortem published Oct 1 |
| Pillar Bank relationship summary | Northfield | Aleks / Hana | Oct 16 | Waiting on remediation plan |
| Cohort retention by product | Northfield | Jordan | Oct 16 | In progress |
| Engineering org and hiring plan | Northfield | Maya | Oct 12 | Hiring Plan - Post Series B |

## Risks to close

Risk: The Sep 26 duplicate round-up debits incident lands in the middle of diligence. Northfield has asked how it relates to the April 6 outage. Answer: different system (legacy Rails/Sidekiq round-up sweep, not the new ACH pipeline), caught in 47 minutes by reconciliation alerting, reversed the same day. The fix (ADR-031 - Idempotency Keys for All Money-Moving Jobs) is due Oct 23.

Risk: Investing GA slips past Oct 20. Northfield underwrote "investing live" for Q4. A slip of a couple of weeks is fine; a slip past close is a conversation.

Risk: SOC 2 gaps are still open when Elena Sorensen asks. Q3 access review is 70% done, vendor risk assessments 2 of 4, MDM at 96%.

Open question: Do we pre-announce the round internally before close? Aleks leaning no, all-hands after signing docs.

## Notes

- Oct 6: Ravi Menon asked for the board deck draft early. Agreed to share the Oct 21 pre-read the same day the board gets it.
- Oct 8: Elena Sorensen sent her topic list for Oct 14. Maya has it.
